title: LLM VM — Arc Pro B70
description: VM 105 (llm, 192.168.50.107): GPU thermals and power from node_exporter hwmon, per-model llama-server metrics (llama-metrics textfile collector), whisper-server GPU/CPU status from real usage (whisper-proxy textfile collector), VM resources. homelab GPU-VM.md Observability.

panels.title: Package temp
panels.description: GPU die. Driver crit 100 °C; LlmGpuHot fires above 90 °C for 5 min.

targets.expr: max(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{instance="llm"} * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{instance="llm", label=~"pkg"})

panels.title: VRAM temp
panels.description: Hottest of the memory sensors the driver reports as `vram`. Crit 105 °C.

targets.expr: max(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{instance="llm"} * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{instance="llm", label=~"vram"})

panels.title: Board power
panels.description: Whole card, from the energy counter (averaged over the rate window). Power cap 275 W.

targets.expr: sum(rate(node_hwmon_energy_joule_total{instance="llm"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{instance="llm", label=~"card"})
max(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{instance="llm"} * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{instance="llm", label=~"pcie"})
max(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{instance="llm"} * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{instance="llm", label=~"mctrl"})

panels.title: VM 105 exporter
panels.description: 1 = Prometheus can scrape node_exporter on 192.168.50.107:9100.

panels.title: Temperatures
panels.description: Dashed lines: 75 °C (yellow) and the 90 °C alert threshold (red).

targets.expr: node_hwmon_temp_celsius{instance="llm"} * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{instance="llm", label=~"pkg|vram|pcie|mctrl"}

panels.title: Power
panels.description: `card` = whole board, `pkg` = GPU package. Rate of the hwmon energy counters.

targets.expr: rate(node_hwmon_energy_joule_total{instance="llm"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{instance="llm", label=~"card|pkg"}

panels.title: VRAM temperature by channel
panels.description: The 16 memory-channel sensors. A single channel running hot points at airflow across one side of the card.

targets.expr: node_hwmon_temp_celsius{instance="llm"} * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left (label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{instance="llm", label=~"vram_ch_.*"}

panels.title: Status
panels.description: fast is its own service (always on). The router holds one of qwen27 / qwen27-agent / chat at a time; flux2-dev is image mode (sd-server), loaded only while llm-mode image is on. BUSY = a request is being processed. Collected every 15 s by llama-metrics on llm.

targets.expr: max(llamacpp:model_loaded{instance="llm", job="scrapeConfig/observability/llm-node", model="$model"}) + (max(llamacpp:requests_processing{instance="llm", job="scrapeConfig/observability/llm-node", model="$model"}) > bool 0 or on() vector(0))

panels.title: Generation speed (5m)
panels.description: Tokens generated ÷ time spent generating, over the last 5 minutes. Idle when nothing was generated. flux2-dev: seconds per sampling step of the last completed image, from step 2 (step 1 also builds the graph).

targets.expr: max(sd_step_seconds{instance="llm", job="scrapeConfig/observability/llm-node"}) and on() llamacpp:model_loaded{instance="llm", job="scrapeConfig/observability/llm-node", model="flux2-dev", model="$model"}

panels.title: Prompt speed (5m)
panels.description: Prompt tokens processed ÷ time spent on prompts (excludes tokens reused from cache). flux2-dev: seconds the text encoder took on the last completed image's prompt, excluding loading its weights.

targets.expr: max(sd_stage_seconds{instance="llm", job="scrapeConfig/observability/llm-node", stage="encode"}) and on() llamacpp:model_loaded{instance="llm", job="scrapeConfig/observability/llm-node", model="flux2-dev", model="$model"}

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: flux2-dev: 1 while sd-server is generating, through any API.

panels.title: Tokens generated (24h)
panels.description: Across model reloads (increase() handles counter resets). flux2-dev: images saved by sd-proxy.

panels.title: Prompt cache reuse (24h)
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the KV cache instead of recomputed. High is good for agent sessions. flux2-dev has no prompt cache: this shows the last image's request-to-response time instead.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_cached_total{instance="llm", job="scrapeConfig/observability/llm-node", model="$model"}[24h])) / (sum(increase(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_cached_total{instance="llm", job="scrapeConfig/observability/llm-node", model="$model"}[24h])) + sum(increase(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total{instance="llm", job="scrapeConfig/observability/llm-node", model="$model"}[24h])))) and ((sum(increase(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_cached_total{instance="llm", job="scrapeConfig/observability/llm-node", model="$model"}[24h])) + sum(increase(llamacpp:prompt_tokens_total{instance="llm", job="scrapeConfig/observability/llm-node", model="$model"}[24h]))) > 0)

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Tokens per second over the rate window. Gaps are periods the model was not loaded. flux2-dev: seconds per sampling step of the last completed image (right axis).

targets.expr: max(sd_step_seconds{instance="llm", job="scrapeConfig/observability/llm-node"}) and on() llamacpp:model_loaded{instance="llm", job="scrapeConfig/observability/llm-node", model="flux2-dev", model="$model"}

panels.title: Card mode
panels.description: Which llm-mode the card is in, from systemd unit state (llama-metrics). normal = fast + router + whisper; agent = router alone; image = sd-server alone, with no LLM or speech-to-text.

targets.expr: max(llm_mode{instance="llm", mode="normal"}) * 1 + max(llm_mode{instance="llm", mode="agent"}) * 2 + max(llm_mode{instance="llm", mode="image"}) * 3

panels.title: VRAM used
panels.description: From xpu-smi, every 15 s. The card has 31.9 GiB; FLUX.2-dev peaks near 29 GiB while sampling and drops to ~1 GiB between images (--offload-to-cpu).

panels.title: Generating now
panels.description: Whether sd-server is generating, through any API (async /sdcpp/v1 jobs included), from its log. No data = image mode off.

panels.title: Images (24h)
panels.description: Images saved to /models/images/ by sd-proxy. The counter resets when the proxy restarts; increase() accounts for that.

panels.title: Last generation
panels.description: Wall time of the most recent generation: request time for synchronous routes, started → completed for async jobs. ~7-8 min at the defaults (1024², 28 steps)

panels.title: Failed generations (24h)
panels.description: Synchronous generation requests that got a non-200 from sd-server, or no answer (502). journalctl -u sd-server on llm has the cause.

panels.title: VRAM used
panels.description: Whole-card VRAM in every mode, so the image-mode climb (text encoder ~11 GiB, then the diffusion model ~29 GiB) is visible next to normal-mode use.

panels.title: Generation time
panels.description: Per-image wall time. Steps and resolution dominate: ~12.5 s per sampling step at 1024², plus ~8-30 s prompt encoding and ~50 s moving the diffusion model onto the card.

panels.title: Stages (last image)
panels.description: Where the last completed image's time went, from sd-server's log. weights = moving each model onto the card (--offload-to-cpu); encode = text encoder on the prompt; sample = the diffusion steps; decode = VAE.

panels.title: Reachable
panels.description: 1 = whisper-proxy is running, which it does only once whisper-server has finished its warm-up; 0 = stopped, e.g. in image mode (llm-mode image stops whisper-server). Set on start and stop, not by a periodic check.

panels.title: Device
panels.description: Classified from the most recent real transcription's latency: <1 s = GPU (SYCL), ≥1 s = CPU fallback (VOICE.md V1f). whisper-server logs its device only once at startup, so this is the live signal for a silent fallback afterward — but it only updates when someone actually talks to the assistant. No data when whisper-server is unreachable — see the Reachable panel.

panels.title: Inference latency (avg, real usage)
panels.description: Cumulative average over every real transcription whisper-proxy has timed since it last restarted. SYCL runs ~0.21 s; CPU fallback ~1.8 s (VOICE.md V1f, 2026-09-17). The 1 s line is the Device panel's GPU/CPU cutoff.

panels.title: Inference latency history
panels.description: Cumulative average latency across real transcriptions, from whisper-proxy — flat where nobody's used the assistant, since it only updates on real usage. Dashed line: the 1 s GPU/CPU-fallback cutoff. A rise from ~0.2 s toward ~1.8 s that stays up is a SYCL fallback, not a fluke.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Page cache holding model files is not counted as used.
